select pysw.*,pyp.code as productCode from pur_yt_store_warning as pysw left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = pysw.product_id left join sal_yt_customer as syc on syc.id=pysw.customer_id left join sal_yt_customer_store as sycs on sycs.customer_id = pysw.customer_id and sycs.product_id = pysw.product_id and sycs.specification_id = pysw.specification_id where pysw.is_deleted=0 and (sycs.status = 1 or sycs.id is null)
and pysw.store_name like concat('%',#{storeName},'%')
and pyp.code like concat('%',#{productCode},'%')
mapper.update: update pur_yt_store_warning set is_deleted=1 WHERE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 0 DAY) > warning_time
